evidence.text: Cala answer: ## Seed-Round Investors in Finnish Climate Tech Software Companies (Since 2024) Based on available deal data, the following investors have led or participated in seed rounds for climate tech and green-transition software companies in Finland since 2024: ### Greencode Ventures (Helsinki) A European early-stage climate-tech VC investing in digital-first green transition startups from seed to Series A. Notable seed-stage deals in Finland since 2024 include: - **Sustashift** — Seed round (January 2025), led by Greencode Ventures with participation from Wave Ventures. Sustashift operates in sustainability compliance software. - **Groundhawk** — €2M seed round (February 2026), co-led by Greencode Ventures and 2C Ventures. Groundhawk works in energy and construction software. - **Cronvall** — €3.9M seed round (November 2025), raised from Greencode Ventures, Stephen Industries, and Innovestor. Cronvall operates in e-commerce/logistics/manufacturing. - **Lumoview** — €3M seed round (May 2025), with Greencode Ventures, IBB Ventures, and WakeUp Capital. Lumoview provides building energy assessment software (based in Germany but with Finnish investor involvement). - **Renow** — €1.8M seed round (June 2025), led by Greencode Ventures, joined by Superhero Capital and Street Smart Capital. ### Lifeline Ventures (Helsinki) A prominent Finnish early-stage VC. Climate-adjacent software seed deals include: - **Synergi** — Seed round (October 2024). Synergi provides smart electricity management and demand response software for households. Investors include Lifeline Ventures and Greencode Ventures. ### Capalo AI - **Capalo AI** — €3.8M seed round (March 2025) with VentureFriends, PROfounders Capital, Inventure, and Innovestor. Capalo AI is a Finnish AI-powered energy software company. ### CeLLife Technologies - **CeLLife Technologies** — €4M seed extension (May 2026), backed by 2C Ventures, Butterfly Ventures, and the European Innovation Council (EIC). CeLLife operates in cleantech/energy/manufacturing software in Finland. --- **Greencode Ventures** stands out as the most active lead investor in Finnish climate tech software seed rounds since 2024, consistent with its stated focus on digital-first green transition startups in Europe. **Lifeline Ventures**, **Wave Ventures**, **Superhero Capital**, **2C Ventures**, and **Innovestor** have also participated in or co-led relevant rounds during this period.

evidence.title: Cala summary: investors leading rounds at your stage
evidence.text: Cala answer: ## Seed-Round Investors in Finnish Climate Tech Software Companies (Since 2024) Based on available deal data, the following investors have led or participated in seed rounds for climate tech and green-transition software companies in Finland since 2024: ### Greencode Ventures (Helsinki) A European early-stage climate-tech VC investing in digital-first green transition startups from seed to Series A. Notable seed-stage deals in Finland since 2024 include: - **Sustashift** — Seed round (January 2025), led by Greencode Ventures with participation from Wave Ventures. Sustashift operates in sustainability compliance software. - **Groundhawk** — €2M seed round (February 2026), co-led by Greencode Ventures and 2C Ventures. Groundhawk works in energy and construction software. - **Cronvall** — €3.9M seed round (November 2025), raised from Greencode Ventures, Stephen Industries, and Innovestor. Cronvall operates in e-commerce/logistics/manufacturing. - **Lumoview** — €3M seed round (May 2025), with Greencode Ventures, IBB Ventures, and WakeUp Capital. Lumoview provides building energy assessment software (based in Germany but with Finnish investor involvement). - **Renow** — €1.8M seed round (June 2025), led by Greencode Ventures, joined by Superhero Capital and Street Smart Capital. ### Lifeline Ventures (Helsinki) A prominent Finnish early-stage VC. Climate-adjacent software seed deals include: - **Synergi** — Seed round (October 2024). Synergi provides smart electricity management and demand response software for households. Investors include Lifeline Ventures and Greencode Ventures. ### Capalo AI - **Capalo AI** — €3.8M seed round (March 2025) with VentureFriends, PROfounders Capital, Inventure, and Innovestor. Capalo AI is a Finnish AI-powered energy software company. ### CeLLife Technologies - **CeLLife Technologies** — €4M seed extension (May 2026), backed by 2C Ventures, Butterfly Ventures, and the European Innovation Council (EIC). CeLLife operates in cleantech/energy/manufacturing software in Finland. --- **Greencode Ventures** stands out as the most active lead investor in Finnish climate tech software seed rounds since 2024, consistent with its stated focus on digital-first green transition startups in Europe. **Lifeline Ventures**, **Wave Ventures**, **Superhero Capital**, **2C Ventures**, and **Innovestor** have also participated in or co-led relevant rounds during this period.

Based on available information, the most relevant company identified is: --- ### 1. Sustashift (Helsinki, Finland) - **Founded:** 2023 - **What they do:** Sustashift automates CSRD reporting for companies of all sizes, including smaller, non-listed companies. Their software features automated XBRL digital tagging (reducing tagging time from ~500 hours to 5 seconds) and automatically tailored reporting templates to produce CSRD-compliant sustainability reports. They serve as the official sustainability advisor to the automotive, chemical, and retail industries of Finland. - **Total funding raised:** ~$841K (per PitchBook); Tracxn reports the latest Seed round at approximately $787K–$841K. - **Latest funding round:** **Seed** (February 2025), led by **Greencode Ventures** with participation from **Wave Ventures**. evidence.text: Cala answer: ## Finnish Startups & Companies Building AI-Powered CSRD Reporting for SMEs The niche of AI-driven CSRD (Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive) automation specifically for small and mid-sized companies in Finland's climate tech software sector is still emerging. Based on available information, the most relevant company identified is: --- ### 1. Sustashift (Helsinki, Finland) - **Founded:** 2023 - **What they do:** Sustashift automates CSRD reporting for companies of all sizes, including smaller, non-listed companies. Their software features automated XBRL digital tagging (reducing tagging time from ~500 hours to 5 seconds) and automatically tailored reporting templates to produce CSRD-compliant sustainability reports. They serve as the official sustainability advisor to the automotive, chemical, and retail industries of Finland. - **Total funding raised:** ~$841K (per PitchBook); Tracxn reports the latest Seed round at approximately $787K–$841K. - **Latest funding round:** **Seed** (February 2025), led by **Greencode Ventures** with participation from **Wave Ventures**. The exact round amount was not publicly disclosed by the company, though data platforms estimate it at ~$787K. - **CEO:** Verneri Laakkonen (former corporate lawyer) --- ### Adjacent Finnish Climate Tech / Sustainability Software Startups While the following companies operate in Finland's sustainability/climate tech software space, they are **not specifically focused on AI-powered CSRD reporting for SMEs**: | Company | Focus | Total Funding | Latest Round | |---------|-------|---------------|--------------| | **Kausal** (Helsinki) | Software platform helping cities manage climate action plans and sustainability targets | ~$932K (€880K) | Seed (Oct 2023), investors: Innovestor, Zubi Capital | | **Upright** (Helsinki) | Net impact measurement and double materiality assessments for companies (offers free AI-driven double materiality tool) | Not specified in sources | — | --- ### Key Takeaway **Sustashift** is the most prominent Finnish startup specifically building AI-automated CSRD reporting software targeting both large and smaller/non-listed companies. The broader Finnish climate tech ecosystem includes many startups (e.g., in clean energy, circular economy), but dedicated AI-powered CSRD compliance tools for SMEs remain a very narrow niche in Finland, with Sustashift being the clear frontrunner. evidence.text: Cala answer: ## Seed-Round Investors in Finnish Climate Tech Software Companies (Since 2024) Based on available deal data, the following investors have led or participated in seed rounds for climate tech and green-transition software companies in Finland since 2024: ### Greencode Ventures (Helsinki) A European early-stage climate-tech VC investing in digital-first green transition startups from seed to Series A. Notable seed-stage deals in Finland since 2024 include: - **Sustashift** — Seed round (January 2025), led by Greencode Ventures with participation from Wave Ventures. Sustashift operates in sustainability compliance software. - **Groundhawk** — €2M seed round (February 2026), co-led by Greencode Ventures and 2C Ventures. Groundhawk works in energy and construction software. - **Cronvall** — €3.9M seed round (November 2025), raised from Greencode Ventures, Stephen Industries, and Innovestor. Cronvall operates in e-commerce/logistics/manufacturing. - **Lumoview** — €3M seed round (May 2025), with Greencode Ventures, IBB Ventures, and WakeUp Capital. Lumoview provides building energy assessment software (based in Germany but with Finnish investor involvement). - **Renow** — €1.8M seed round (June 2025), led by Greencode Ventures, joined by Superhero Capital and Street Smart Capital. ### Lifeline Ventures (Helsinki) A prominent Finnish early-stage VC. Climate-adjacent software seed deals include: - **Synergi** — Seed round (October 2024). Synergi provides smart electricity management and demand response software for households. Investors include Lifeline Ventures and Greencode Ventures. ### Capalo AI - **Capalo AI** — €3.8M seed round (March 2025) with VentureFriends, PROfounders Capital, Inventure, and Innovestor. Capalo AI is a Finnish AI-powered energy software company. ### CeLLife Technologies - **CeLLife Technologies** — €4M seed extension (May 2026), backed by 2C Ventures, Butterfly Ventures, and the European Innovation Council (EIC). CeLLife operates in cleantech/energy/manufacturing software in Finland. --- **Greencode Ventures** stands out as the most active lead investor in Finnish climate tech software seed rounds since 2024, consistent with its stated focus on digital-first green transition startups in Europe. **Lifeline Ventures**, **Wave Ventures**, **Superhero Capital**, **2C Ventures**, and **Innovestor** have also participated in or co-led relevant rounds during this period.

evidence.text: Cala answer: ## Finnish Startups & Companies Building AI-Powered CSRD Reporting for SMEs The niche of AI-driven CSRD (Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive) automation specifically for small and mid-sized companies in Finland's climate tech software sector is still emerging. Based on available information, the most relevant company identified is: --- ### 1. Sustashift (Helsinki, Finland) - **Founded:** 2023 - **What they do:** Sustashift automates CSRD reporting for companies of all sizes, including smaller, non-listed companies. Their software features automated XBRL digital tagging (reducing tagging time from ~500 hours to 5 seconds) and automatically tailored reporting templates to produce CSRD-compliant sustainability reports. They serve as the official sustainability advisor to the automotive, chemical, and retail industries of Finland. - **Total funding raised:** ~$841K (per PitchBook); Tracxn reports the latest Seed round at approximately $787K–$841K. - **Latest funding round:** **Seed** (February 2025), led by **Greencode Ventures** with participation from **Wave Ventures**. The broader Finnish climate tech ecosystem includes many startups (e.g., in clean energy, circular economy), but dedicated AI-powered CSRD compliance tools for SMEs remain a very narrow niche in Finland, with Sustashift being the clear frontrunner. evidence.text: Cala answer: ## Seed-Round Investors in Finnish Climate Tech Software Companies (Since 2024) Based on available deal data, the following investors have led or participated in seed rounds for climate tech and green-transition software companies in Finland since 2024: ### Greencode Ventures (Helsinki) A European early-stage climate-tech VC investing in digital-first green transition startups from seed to Series A. Notable seed-stage deals in Finland since 2024 include: - **Sustashift** — Seed round (January 2025), led by Greencode Ventures with participation from Wave Ventures. Sustashift operates in sustainability compliance software. - **Groundhawk** — €2M seed round (February 2026), co-led by Greencode Ventures and 2C Ventures. Groundhawk works in energy and construction software. - **Cronvall** — €3.9M seed round (November 2025), raised from Greencode Ventures, Stephen Industries, and Innovestor. Cronvall operates in e-commerce/logistics/manufacturing. - **Lumoview** — €3M seed round (May 2025), with Greencode Ventures, IBB Ventures, and WakeUp Capital. Lumoview provides building energy assessment software (based in Germany but with Finnish investor involvement). - **Renow** — €1.8M seed round (June 2025), led by Greencode Ventures, joined by Superhero Capital and Street Smart Capital. ### Lifeline Ventures (Helsinki) A prominent Finnish early-stage VC. Climate-adjacent software seed deals include: - **Synergi** — Seed round (October 2024). Synergi provides smart electricity management and demand response software for households. Investors include Lifeline Ventures and Greencode Ventures. ### Capalo AI - **Capalo AI** — €3.8M seed round (March 2025) with VentureFriends, PROfounders Capital, Inventure, and Innovestor. Capalo AI is a Finnish AI-powered energy software company. ### CeLLife Technologies - **CeLLife Technologies** — €4M seed extension (May 2026), backed by 2C Ventures, Butterfly Ventures, and the European Innovation Council (EIC). CeLLife operates in cleantech/energy/manufacturing software in Finland. --- **Greencode Ventures** stands out as the most active lead investor in Finnish climate tech software seed rounds since 2024, consistent with its stated focus on digital-first green transition startups in Europe. **Lifeline Ventures**, **Wave Ventures**, **Superhero Capital**, **2C Ventures**, and **Innovestor** have also participated in or co-led relevant rounds during this period.

evidence.text: Cala answer: ## Finnish Startups & Companies Building AI-Powered CSRD Reporting for SMEs The niche of AI-driven CSRD (Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive) automation specifically for small and mid-sized companies in Finland's climate tech software sector is still emerging. Based on available information, the most relevant company identified is: --- ### 1. Sustashift (Helsinki, Finland) - **Founded:** 2023 - **What they do:** Sustashift automates CSRD reporting for companies of all sizes, including smaller, non-listed companies. Their software features automated XBRL digital tagging (reducing tagging time from ~500 hours to 5 seconds) and automatically tailored reporting templates to produce CSRD-compliant sustainability reports. They serve as the official sustainability advisor to the automotive, chemical, and retail industries of Finland. - **Total funding raised:** ~$841K (per PitchBook); Tracxn reports the latest Seed round at approximately $787K–$841K. - **Latest funding round:** **Seed** (February 2025), led by **Greencode Ventures** with participation from **Wave Ventures**. The exact round amount was not publicly disclosed by the company, though data platforms estimate it at ~$787K. - **CEO:** Verneri Laakkonen (former corporate lawyer) --- ### Adjacent Finnish Climate Tech / Sustainability Software Startups While the following companies operate in Finland's sustainability/climate tech software space, they are **not specifically focused on AI-powered CSRD reporting for SMEs**: | Company | Focus | Total Funding | Latest Round | |---------|-------|---------------|--------------| | **Kausal** (Helsinki) | Software platform helping cities manage climate action plans and sustainability targets | ~$932K (€880K) | Seed (Oct 2023), investors: Innovestor, Zubi Capital | | **Upright** (Helsinki) | Net impact measurement and double materiality assessments for companies (offers free AI-driven double materiality tool) | Not specified in sources | — | --- ### Key Takeaway **Sustashift** is the most prominent Finnish startup specifically building AI-automated CSRD reporting software targeting both large and smaller/non-listed companies. The broader Finnish climate tech ecosystem includes many startups (e.g., in clean energy, circular economy), but dedicated AI-powered CSRD compliance tools for SMEs remain a very narrow niche in Finland, with Sustashift being the clear frontrunner. evidence.text: Cala answer: ## Seed-Round Investors in Finnish Climate Tech Software Companies (Since 2024) Based on available deal data, the following investors have led or participated in seed rounds for climate tech and green-transition software companies in Finland since 2024: ### Greencode Ventures (Helsinki) A European early-stage climate-tech VC investing in digital-first green transition startups from seed to Series A. Notable seed-stage deals in Finland since 2024 include: - **Sustashift** — Seed round (January 2025), led by Greencode Ventures with participation from Wave Ventures. Sustashift operates in sustainability compliance software. - **Groundhawk** — €2M seed round (February 2026), co-led by Greencode Ventures and 2C Ventures. Groundhawk works in energy and construction software. - **Cronvall** — €3.9M seed round (November 2025), raised from Greencode Ventures, Stephen Industries, and Innovestor. Cronvall operates in e-commerce/logistics/manufacturing. - **Lumoview** — €3M seed round (May 2025), with Greencode Ventures, IBB Ventures, and WakeUp Capital. Lumoview provides building energy assessment software (based in Germany but with Finnish investor involvement). - **Renow** — €1.8M seed round (June 2025), led by Greencode Ventures, joined by Superhero Capital and Street Smart Capital. ### Lifeline Ventures (Helsinki) A prominent Finnish early-stage VC. Climate-adjacent software seed deals include: - **Synergi** — Seed round (October 2024). Synergi provides smart electricity management and demand response software for households. members.headline: Strong Finnish seed climate software market can support a €2.5M round
members.argument: Finnish climate software startups routinely secure €2M to €3.9M seed rounds, such as Groundhawk and Lumoview (E1, E6). Software remains Finland's most funded startup sector, and active investors like Lifeline Ventures and Superhero Capital can comfortably syndicate a €2.5M seed syndicate (E1, E10, E16).

members.headline: Entrenched direct competitor Sustashift blocks Greencode and captures key market share
members.argument: Direct competitor Sustashift already dominates Finnish AI CSRD reporting with €1M sales and official sector advisory roles (E19, E21, E25). Key climate lead Greencode Ventures and Wave Ventures already back Sustashift (E1, E20, E21), leaving Ledgerly facing severe syndicate conflict and high target round execution risk (E19).

members.headline: Viable raise if Ledgerly pitches unconflicted generalist and climate venture funds
members.argument: While Greencode is conflicted by Sustashift (E1, E21), other active Finnish seed investors like Lifeline Ventures, Superhero Capital, and 2C Ventures are free of direct CSRD conflicts (E1, E4, E14). Ledgerly can raise €2.5M only if it demonstrates distinct product advantages against Sustashift's legal automation (E20, E24).

committee.consensus: Ledgerly can achieve its €2.5M seed round only by targeting unconflicted investors like Lifeline Ventures and Superhero Capital, while clearly differentiating its CSRD automation against Greencode-backed incumbent Sustashift.

Apply for non-dilutive grant and support funding from Business Finland to de-risk round.

Note that exact amounts are partially obscured in some sources; where available, details are included. ### Key Rounds | Company | Round Type | Date | Amount (approx.) | Lead / Key Investors | |---|---|---|---|---| | **eMabler** (EV charging SaaS & energy management platform) | Series A | Jun 16, 2026 | ~$4.8M total raised to date | **Greencode Ventures** (lead) + 3 others; earlier investors include Nidoco, Business Finland | | **Reduciner** (sustainability/energy efficiency software) | Series A | May 5, 2026 | Undisclosed (est. ~$3–4M) | **Voima Ventures** + 3 others | | **Reduciner** | Series A (follow-on) | Sep 23, 2026 | Undisclosed | Not disclosed | | **Cactos** (AI-powered smart energy storage systems) | Seed | 2026 | Undisclosed | **Tesi** (Finnish Industry Investment) | | **Skyfora** (weather data & climate analytics platform) | Series B | Jun 9, 2026 | Undisclosed (est. ~$4.5M) | **Eviny** + 3 others | | **Puro.earth** (carbon removal marketplace platform) | Series B | Sep 4, 2025 | Undisclosed (est. ~$7.8M) | **Fortum** | | **Volare** (sustainability tech) | Series A | Oct 26, 2026 | Undisclosed (est. ~$6M) | **Springvest** + 1 other | | **Hukka AI** (food waste reduction SaaS for kitchens) | Pre-Seed | Jan 2022 | Undisclosed | **Gorilla Capital** | ### Market Context - Finland's cleantech sector raised approximately **€87M** in 2025 and **€4.9M in Q1 2026 / €2.5M in Q2 2026** specifically in cleantech, according to Tech.eu data. evidence.text: Cala answer: ## Finnish Startups & Companies Building AI-Powered CSRD Reporting for SMEs The niche of AI-driven CSRD (Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive) automation specifically for small and mid-sized companies in Finland's climate tech software sector is still emerging. Based on available information, the most relevant company identified is: --- ### 1. Sustashift (Helsinki, Finland) - **Founded:** 2023 - **What they do:** Sustashift automates CSRD reporting for companies of all sizes, including smaller, non-listed companies. Their software features automated XBRL digital tagging (reducing tagging time from ~500 hours to 5 seconds) and automatically tailored reporting templates to produce CSRD-compliant sustainability reports. They serve as the official sustainability advisor to the automotive, chemical, and retail industries of Finland. - **Total funding raised:** ~$841K (per PitchBook); Tracxn reports the latest Seed round at approximately $787K–$841K. - **Latest funding round:** **Seed** (February 2025), led by **Greencode Ventures** with participation from **Wave Ventures**. members.headline: Strong Finnish seed climate software market can support a €2.5M round
members.argument: Finnish climate software startups routinely secure €2M to €3.9M seed rounds, such as Groundhawk and Lumoview (E1, E6). Software remains Finland's most funded startup sector, and active investors like Lifeline Ventures and Superhero Capital can comfortably syndicate a €2.5M seed syndicate (E1, E10, E16).

members.headline: Entrenched direct competitor Sustashift blocks Greencode and captures key market share
members.argument: Direct competitor Sustashift already dominates Finnish AI CSRD reporting with €1M sales and official sector advisory roles (E19, E21, E25). Key climate lead Greencode Ventures and Wave Ventures already back Sustashift (E1, E20, E21), leaving Ledgerly facing severe syndicate conflict and high target round execution risk (E19).

members.headline: Viable raise if Ledgerly pitches unconflicted generalist and climate venture funds
members.argument: While Greencode is conflicted by Sustashift (E1, E21), other active Finnish seed investors like Lifeline Ventures, Superhero Capital, and 2C Ventures are free of direct CSRD conflicts (E1, E4, E14). Ledgerly can raise €2.5M only if it demonstrates distinct product advantages against Sustashift's legal automation (E20, E24).

committee.consensus: Ledgerly can achieve its €2.5M seed round only by targeting unconflicted investors like Lifeline Ventures and Superhero Capital, while clearly differentiating its CSRD automation against Greencode-backed incumbent Sustashift.

evidence.title: Cala summary: investors leading rounds at your stage
evidence.text: Cala answer: ## Seed-Round Investors in Finnish Climate Tech Software Companies (Since 2024) Based on available deal data, the following investors have led or participated in seed rounds for climate tech and green-transition software companies in Finland since 2024: ### Greencode Ventures (Helsinki) A European early-stage climate-tech VC investing in digital-first green transition startups from seed to Series A. Notable seed-stage deals in Finland since 2024 include: - **Sustashift** — Seed round (January 2025), led by Greencode Ventures with participation from Wave Ventures. Sustashift operates in sustainability compliance software. - **Groundhawk** — €2M seed round (February 2026), co-led by Greencode Ventures and 2C Ventures. Groundhawk works in energy and construction software. - **Cronvall** — €3.9M seed round (November 2025), raised from Greencode Ventures, Stephen Industries, and Innovestor. Cronvall operates in e-commerce/logistics/manufacturing. - **Lumoview** — €3M seed round (May 2025), with Greencode Ventures, IBB Ventures, and WakeUp Capital. Lumoview provides building energy assessment software (based in Germany but with Finnish investor involvement). - **Renow** — €1.8M seed round (June 2025), led by Greencode Ventures, joined by Superhero Capital and Street Smart Capital. ### Lifeline Ventures (Helsinki) A prominent Finnish early-stage VC. Climate-adjacent software seed deals include: - **Synergi** — Seed round (October 2024). Synergi provides smart electricity management and demand response software for households. Investors include Lifeline Ventures and Greencode Ventures. ### Capalo AI - **Capalo AI** — €3.8M seed round (March 2025) with VentureFriends, PROfounders Capital, Inventure, and Innovestor. Capalo AI is a Finnish AI-powered energy software company. ### CeLLife Technologies - **CeLLife Technologies** — €4M seed extension (May 2026), backed by 2C Ventures, Butterfly Ventures, and the European Innovation Council (EIC). CeLLife operates in cleantech/energy/manufacturing software in Finland. --- **Greencode Ventures** stands out as the most active lead investor in Finnish climate tech software seed rounds since 2024, consistent with its stated focus on digital-first green transition startups in Europe. **Lifeline Ventures**, **Wave Ventures**, **Superhero Capital**, **2C Ventures**, and **Innovestor** have also participated in or co-led relevant rounds during this period.

evidence.text: Cala answer: ## Finnish Startups & Companies Building AI-Powered CSRD Reporting for SMEs The niche of AI-driven CSRD (Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive) automation specifically for small and mid-sized companies in Finland's climate tech software sector is still emerging. Based on available information, the most relevant company identified is: --- ### 1. Sustashift (Helsinki, Finland) - **Founded:** 2023 - **What they do:** Sustashift automates CSRD reporting for companies of all sizes, including smaller, non-listed companies. Their software features automated XBRL digital tagging (reducing tagging time from ~500 hours to 5 seconds) and automatically tailored reporting templates to produce CSRD-compliant sustainability reports. They serve as the official sustainability advisor to the automotive, chemical, and retail industries of Finland. - **Total funding raised:** ~$841K (per PitchBook); Tracxn reports the latest Seed round at approximately $787K–$841K. - **Latest funding round:** **Seed** (February 2025), led by **Greencode Ventures** with participation from **Wave Ventures**. The exact round amount was not publicly disclosed by the company, though data platforms estimate it at ~$787K. - **CEO:** Verneri Laakkonen (former corporate lawyer) --- ### Adjacent Finnish Climate Tech / Sustainability Software Startups While the following companies operate in Finland's sustainability/climate tech software space, they are **not specifically focused on AI-powered CSRD reporting for SMEs**: | Company | Focus | Total Funding | Latest Round | |---------|-------|---------------|--------------| | **Kausal** (Helsinki) | Software platform helping cities manage climate action plans and sustainability targets | ~$932K (€880K) | Seed (Oct 2023), investors: Innovestor, Zubi Capital | | **Upright** (Helsinki) | Net impact measurement and double materiality assessments for companies (offers free AI-driven double materiality tool) | Not specified in sources | — | --- ### Key Takeaway **Sustashift** is the most prominent Finnish startup specifically building AI-automated CSRD reporting software targeting both large and smaller/non-listed companies. The broader Finnish climate tech ecosystem includes many startups (e.g., in clean energy, circular economy), but dedicated AI-powered CSRD compliance tools for SMEs remain a very narrow niche in Finland, with Sustashift being the clear frontrunner. members.headline: Strong Finnish seed climate software market can support a €2.5M round
members.argument: Finnish climate software startups routinely secure €2M to €3.9M seed rounds, such as Groundhawk and Lumoview (E1, E6). Software remains Finland's most funded startup sector, and active investors like Lifeline Ventures and Superhero Capital can comfortably syndicate a €2.5M seed syndicate (E1, E10, E16).

members.headline: Entrenched direct competitor Sustashift blocks Greencode and captures key market share
members.argument: Direct competitor Sustashift already dominates Finnish AI CSRD reporting with €1M sales and official sector advisory roles (E19, E21, E25). Key climate lead Greencode Ventures and Wave Ventures already back Sustashift (E1, E20, E21), leaving Ledgerly facing severe syndicate conflict and high target round execution risk (E19).

members.headline: Viable raise if Ledgerly pitches unconflicted generalist and climate venture funds
members.argument: While Greencode is conflicted by Sustashift (E1, E21), other active Finnish seed investors like Lifeline Ventures, Superhero Capital, and 2C Ventures are free of direct CSRD conflicts (E1, E4, E14). Ledgerly can raise €2.5M only if it demonstrates distinct product advantages against Sustashift's legal automation (E20, E24).

committee.consensus: Ledgerly can achieve its €2.5M seed round only by targeting unconflicted investors like Lifeline Ventures and Superhero Capital, while clearly differentiating its CSRD automation against Greencode-backed incumbent Sustashift.

scenarios.name: Regulatory and Capital Drought
scenarios.oneLiner: Chilled seed funding and lax enforcement stall SME demand and investor commitments.
scenarios.narrative: Finnish seed funding drops while delayed CSRD reporting relieves SME compliance pressure. With Greencode backing Sustashift and broad VCs retreating, Ledgerly struggles to secure lead interest, falling far short of its €2.5M seed funding target.
signposts: Finnish quarterly seed volume declines below €10M.
SMEs delay compliance software procurement deadlines.
Generalist VCs bypass early-stage climate tech software.

scenarios.name: Regulatory Mandate Without Capital
scenarios.oneLiner: Surging SME compliance demand clashes with tight venture funding and incumbent lead.
scenarios.narrative: CSRD enforcement sparks high demand among SMEs, yet local venture liquidity remains scarce. Because Greencode and Wave backed Sustashift, Ledgerly competes fiercely for limited syndicates like Lifeline or Superhero, forcing a smaller round or convertible bridge.
signposts: Sustashift expands client agreements across retail and chemical sectors.
Finnish VCs limit seed cheque sizes below €2M.
Business Finland grant matching becomes mandatory for syndication.

scenarios.name: Capital Flush Amid Slow Adoption
scenarios.oneLiner: Abundant seed liquidity chases climate tech but SME demand lags expectations.
scenarios.narrative: Finnish venture investors actively deploy capital across software, but small businesses defer CSRD reporting investments. Ledgerly attracts investor dialogue based on vision, but soft customer traction restricts round closure to a reduced valuation and target.
signposts: Finland quarterly seed funding matches record levels above €20M.
SME trial conversion rates for CSRD software stall.
Seed funds pivot toward energy software over compliance.

scenarios.name: Green Transition Tailwinds
scenarios.oneLiner: Booming compliance needs and eager syndicate investors unlock the full round.
scenarios.narrative: Urgent CSRD reporting deadlines push SMEs into software adoption, creating rapid ARR growth. Non-Greencode investors like Lifeline, Superhero, and Innovestor aggressively syndicate a €2.5M round, supported by Business Finland co-funding to compete directly with Sustashift.
signposts: Lifeline Ventures or Superhero Capital issues a term sheet.
Business Finland approves co-funding alongside lead venture investor.
Ledgerly demonstrates commercial wins against existing incumbents.

event.question: Will Ledgerly close a seed round of about EUR 2,500,000 within 12 months?
event.explanation: Ledgerly aims to close a €2.5M seed round within 12 months for its AI CSRD reporting tool. Its probability hinges on overcoming portfolio conflict barriers—given that premier climate fund Greencode and Wave Ventures already backed direct competitor Sustashift—by assembling an alternative syndicate among funds like Lifeline, Superhero, Innovestor, and Business Finland as CSRD compliance deadlines approach.
